title: Cross-organization seat write through Work Setup operators/backups
rootCause: saveWorkSetup validated only primaryRepId against organization membership; operator/backup ids were passed unchecked to configureCoverageStatement, and the pc_insert/ia_insert RLS policies check the row organization_id but not that rep_id belongs to that organization.
evidence: src/lib/operations/work-setup-write.ts:103-111 (only primary checked); src/lib/coverage/configure.ts:117-135 (inserts arbitrary rep ids); supabase/migrations/20261106120000_operations_autopilot.sql:144-146 (pc_insert); 20261101160000_close_anon_exposure.sql:144-146 (ia_insert)
impact: An authenticated admin/manager could write a rep from another organization into profile_coverage and identity_assignments, polluting the target population and arming notifications for a foreign rep.
fix: Added assertSeatsInOrg() and called it from configureCoverage() and assignBackupResponsibility().

title: Work Setup allocation replace could leave a lane with zero active allocations
rootCause: dpa_active_uniq is a partial unique index on (plan_id, rep_id) WHERE active, so the writer deactivated every active share before inserting the new set. A failure between the two statements lost the allocations.
impact: A transient DB error during a routine target edit could silently drop every operator's allocation on a lane, changing assigned/unallocated totals.
fix: Extracted replacePlanAllocations(): update existing shares in place, insert new ones, then deactivate removed ones in one statement.
regressionTest: tests/work-setup-hardening.test.ts (existing share survives a failed insert)
remaining: The whole saveWorkSetup is still not one SQL transaction; see R-13.

title: Local live-test configuration targets the production database
rootCause: .env.local sets DATABASE_URL/SERVICE_DATABASE_URL to the Aiven relay_prod_final database; vitest.live.config.mts loads .env.local and its LIVE_TEST_FILES include write-heavy suites.
evidence: .env.local DATABASE_URL host pg-393a7079-...aivencloud.com/relay_prod_final; vitest.live.config.mts:9; tests/operator-visibility.live.test.ts (26 insert/update/delete calls); tests/v6-live-coverage-acceptance.test.ts (15)
impact: Running `npm run test:live` mutates production. `npm test` also reads production in tests/accountability-service.test.ts (read-only).

title: Organization deletion did not explicitly revoke sessions
rootCause: The route deleted Better Auth users but never called signOutUser; it relied on provider cascade behaviour.
regressionTest: none (provider admin call; verified by typecheck and unit suite)

title: Login `next` sanitizer allowed a backslash protocol-relative redirect
rootCause: sanitizeNextPath rejected only values not starting with '/' and values starting with '//'; browsers fold a backslash to a slash for special URLs.
fix: Reject values containing backslash or whitespace.
regressionTest: none (pure function; covered by tsc and unit suite)

title: GitHub personal access token embedded in the local git remote URL
evidence: git config --get remote.origin.url contained a 40-char ghp_ token in the userinfo (not a tracked file)
fix: Remote URL replaced with https://github.com/aneebiqbal/bpule.relay.git; the token was not printed or persisted.
remaining: The token must be revoked/rotated in GitHub by the owner; pushes now need a credential helper or SSH.

title: Two coexisting AI routing systems
evidence: src/lib/ai/routing.ts (legacy, dated 2026-10-09) is still imported by src/lib/ai/draft-stream.ts, src/lib/ai/draft.ts, src/lib/ai/provider.ts and src/lib/content/intelligence/forge.ts, while src/lib/ai/runtime/* is the canonical router.
impact: Provider selection can diverge depending on entry point; twice the prompt/model configuration to keep in sync.

title: UTC dates in adjacent target/notification surfaces
impact: For a non-UTC organization these surfaces can read or write the wrong business day even though the canonical projection is org-date correct.

title: personal = assigned - unseatedAllocationUnits breaks for a solo-seat lane that carries an allocation
evidence: src/lib/execution/accountability.ts:307-308 counts the full lane target in assigned when seats.length === 1, while lanePersonalTarget:251-252 returns the allocation; unseatedAllocationUnits is 0.
impact: reconcilePopulations.personal can disagree with assigned - unseatedAllocationUnits. Reachable through the admin allocations API.

title: Work Setup cannot clear allocations
evidence: src/lib/operations/work-setup-write.ts:180-194: allocations: [] produces an empty byActivity map, so the replace loop never runs.
impact: An admin who removes every allocation in the UI silently keeps the previous shares.

title: Work Setup permits allocations to unseated reps
evidence: src/lib/operations/work-setup-write.ts:186 checks only organization membership, not lane seats; the read model flags the result as allocation-without-seat drift (src/lib/operations/work-setup.ts:149-152).
impact: Manufactures unseatedAllocationUnits and confuses rep expectations.

title: Dead _userId parameters in workspace authorization helpers
evidence: src/lib/auth/workspace.ts:111,127 accept _userId and never use it; authorization is session-based.
impact: False sense of per-user auth; no runtime exposure.

title: No multi-statement transaction and no optimistic concurrency on Work Setup
evidence: DbClient exposes only from/rpc/raw (src/lib/db/types.ts:104-115); each query is its own transaction (src/lib/db/postgres.ts:150-188). saveWorkSetup commits seats, targets and allocations independently (src/lib/operations/work-setup-write.ts:115-231). No revision/If-Match guard exists.
impact: Two concurrent admins last-writer-wins; a failure after the seat write but before targets leaves a half-applied change.

title: backfillProfileCoverage is a second coverage writer
evidence: src/lib/profiles/canonical.ts:493-519 mutates profile_coverage directly without eligibility, acknowledgement or audit sync; no callers found.
impact: Contradicts the single-writer claim; dead today but a trap for the next change.

title: The stated requirement invariant is not the implemented one
evidence: Task/contract phrasing says requirement = assigned + unallocated; the code implements requirement = requirementAssigned + requirementUnallocated and assigned + unallocated = tracked (src/lib/execution/accountability.ts:451-454, 481-495).
impact: A consumer asserting the wrong equation will report a false mismatch whenever non-targetable lanes exist.
